justification: The decisive claim is false: edge-disjoint tours cannot be adjacent in the symmetric TSP polytope ([Sierksma, Theorem 1](https://pure.rug.nl/ws/files/250587650/Interchange_graphs_and_the_Hamilton_cycle_polytope.pdf)). Their union has another Hamiltonian decomposition C,D, implying c(A)+c(B)=c(C)+c(D). If c(A)<c(B), at least one of C,D must also be cheaper than B, contradicting the proposed ordering. The remaining observations only identify a proof gap.
